definitions.explanation: A round bulb vegetable with layers, used widely in cooking.

examples.japanese: {玉葱|たまねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}ると→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When I cut onions, tears come out.

examples.english: When making hamburger steaks, I dice onions and mix them in.

notes:
{玉葱|たまねぎ} is one of the most commonly used vegetables in Japanese cooking, appearing in curries, stir-fries, soups, and salads. Often written in katakana as タマネギ or hiragana as たまねぎ.

FORMS:
⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (ball) + ⟦{葱|ねぎ}→葱：05189_negi⟧ (green onion) — literally 'ball onion,' distinguishing it from ⟦{長|なが}{葱|ねぎ}→長葱：noentry⟧ (long green onion).

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- ⟦みじん{切|ぎ}り→みじん切り：07472_mijingiri⟧: diced/minced
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧: thinly sliced
- ⟦{飴色|あめいろ}→飴色：28784_ameiro⟧{玉葱|たまねぎ}: caramelized onion
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧{玉葱|たまねぎ}: pickled onion

TYPES:
- ⟦{新|しん}{玉葱|たまねぎ}→新玉葱：noentry⟧: new/spring onion (sweeter, available in spring)
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧{玉葱|たまねぎ}: red onion
- ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧{玉葱|たまねぎ}: purple onion (same as red onion)
